Thanks again for the interest — really appreciate the context you shared on your call last week. To make sure you get EU + US coverage and still include APAC input where possible, can we propose one of the following approaches?

2) Single session earlier in US morning / late Europe evening so APAC can attend briefly (~20 min) before curfew.
3) Two-part: 30 min global demo (US/EU) + 20 min technical deep-dive with APAC in a separate meeting.

Here are concrete slots (all times listed with local conversions):
- Option A: Tue 2026-10-05 09:30 PT / 12:30 ET / 18:30 CEST / 01:30 JST (next day) — APAC can't attend at 01:30 JST.
- Option B: Tue 2026-10-05 07:00 PT / 10:00 ET / 16:00 CEST / 23:00 JST — APAC can attend until 23:00 JST but the curfew might still be tight depending on site.
- Option C: Wed 2026-10-06 08:30 PT / 11:30 ET / 17:30 CEST / 00:30 JST — not ideal for APAC.

I attached a short demo deck and a proposed .ics with the above options to make it easy to pick. If none of these work, tell me the tightest window that works for your team and we’ll propose a split session plan.

Thanks — Karthik
